name: Ted Cruz
subject: What I said on Meet the Press this weekend and what I didn't say
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Ted Cruz for Senate
body:
I was asked about my future this weekend. I told them I'm focused on yours.

| | | | Hey Fellow Conservative, I was just on Meet the Press.... Kristen Welker asked me about 2028. About whether I'm going to run for president again. But here's the truth I told her on national television this weekend, and the truth I want to tell you directly right now: **This is not the season right now.** In the last decade, there has not been another Republican who has campaigned for more Senate candidates, more House candidates, more gubernatorial candidates than I have. I have been on the road. I have been in the arena. I have shown up in states where it was hard and uncomfortable and politically complicated, because that's what this fight demands. __I am doing it again right now_._ I need you to understand what we're actually fighting because this isn't just about seats and majorities and who controls which chamber. This is about something far bigger. **_The Democrat Party I came up watching is gone_.** What replaced it is something my father would have recognized immediately, because he lived it. He was tortured in a Cuban prison. He watched his country get strangled by a communist regime that promised the people everything, free healthcare, free education, power to the people, and delivered misery, silence, and chains. **That ideology, socialism, Marxism, the DSA agenda, is winning Democratic primaries across this country right now.** They elected a Democratic Socialist as mayor of New York City. Their endorsed candidates swept primaries in Michigan and Florida. And now that same machine is flooding money into Senate races that were never supposed to be competitive. **Texas. Iowa. Alaska. Michigan. Georgia.** James Talarico alone has $21.5 million in the bank to try to flip the Texas Senate seat. Democrats are outraising Republicans in nearly every battleground state. The Cook Political Report recently called both Texas and Iowa toss-ups. **_The map is shifting, and money is the reason_.** Chuck Schumer only needs a few of these seats to take back the majority. And the moment he does and the tax cuts get reversed, the border gets opened, conservative judges get blocked, and everything we have fought for gets dismantled piece by piece by people who openly admire the ideology that destroyed my father's country. _I will not let that happen._ I told Kristen Welker this weekend that this is the season of the midterms. I meant it. I am going to spend every day between now and November 3rd on the road, on the trail, fighting for every conservative candidate who needs someone to show up for them. **But I need to know you're fighting with me.** Not in October when it's almost too late. Right now, while there's still time to close the fundraising gap, get ads on the air, and build the ground game that shows up on Election Day. **Will you chip in today? Even $5 sends a message that conservatives are awake, organized, and ready.[[LINK]](https://trk.email.tedcruz.-bX-M9R4M907cyHxWA)** [**[****PROTECT AMERICA - CHIP IN $6 TODAY ->]**](https://trk.email.tedcruz.-XeRg) There will be a season for other conversations. President Trump said it himself -- he thinks I'm talented, and he thinks I might just run again someday. _Someday._ **Today, I'm fighting for the Senate majority, for the Texas race, and for the country my father chose when he had nothing left to lose.** I hope you're fighting with me. For liberty, Ted CruzU.S. Senator - Texas

This is probably our biggest win yet.
As the AG, I'm proud of this one - but as a dad to three kids, I'm excited. This is what I've wanted as a parent, long before becoming AG.
Protecting kids, empowering parents. That was the goal, and this is a historic step.
Here's the story.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/e0a93b58-f3dd-4ade-957c-16a574248bc2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Press conference announcing Meta settlement
* * *
Basically, we said to Meta (the owner of Facebook and Instagram), "Hey, we think you built your apps to addict children, then misled parents about it, and it did a lot of harm to a whole generation of young people."
And Meta basically said, "Nope, we'd never do that."
So we did an investigation and uncovered all these internal documents where they admitted to it. They talked openly about how "our product exploits weaknesses in human psychology" and "Instagram is a drug" and "we're basically pushers." They talked about targeting kids by triggering dopamine hits and how profitable that was - even calling the targeting of teens the "overall company goal" and "critical to the success of Instagram."
Then we showed them this evidence and said, "Look, we got you, time to change your ways."
And Meta said, "Nope, take us to court."
So we did. And the trial started a couple weeks ago.
But several months ago, Meta said they were open to settling. So negotiations began.
We felt confident we would win at trial, so we were only interested in a settlement if it gave us _more than we would get from the court._
We knew we could get a ton of money from the court, but we wouldn't get the most valuable thing we really wanted: a new set of real protections for kids.
We wouldn't get that from the court because that's not how courts typically work. Judges have a hard time crafting detailed limitations on tech companies. It's much easier to just punish a company with a gigantic fine rather than specifying dozens of new software features for it to adopt.
And those new software features were what we really wanted. That's how you protect kids and empower parents, which was our real goal.
So those new features became the focus of our negotiation - not the money.
And naturally, we started very far apart.
Meta's main concern was that any new child safety features they agreed to would put them at a competitive disadvantage against Youtube, Tiktok, and Snapchat.
The big break came when they agreed to adopt those provisions unilaterally, without insisting that those other platforms join them.
However, we all agreed it would be best to get these features on all social media platforms, so we wrote the agreement in a way to help that happen.
In other words, this is a big win, but it's designed to set up some even bigger wins by encouraging wider adoption of these new safeguards.
So, yes, this is a huge amount of money for NC. Meta will pay our state a minimum of $451 million and a maximum of $645 million. That makes it one of the largest settlements in state history. By law, those funds will go to the state, and discussions have already begun about how to best use those funds to address the harm that was caused, i.e., youth mental health and wellbeing.
But the money is secondary. The bigger deal is a new set of default settings for every Meta user under 18, which can only be changed with parental approval. Some of them are:
* Two-hour daily limit. (Currently, nearly 40% of teens are using social media for more than five hours per day.)
* No access to feeds from midnight to 6am, so kids can sleep.
* Push notifications disabled during school hours, for fewer distractions during school.
* Beauty filters that mimic cosmetic surgery by changing the face of your face and body are disabled.
* Like counts are hidden, so every post isn't a public ranking in front of your peer group.
* After a long scroll, Meta has to prompt kids to take a break.
* An independent auditor gets access to Meta's internal information and reports on whether the company is actually complying.

Keep in mind, _we did this because Congress didn 't._
For years, we've all known what was happening to kids on social media was bad. But Congress hasn't been able to get reform across the goal line, so it fell to AGs to figure this out.
And it was a huge, bipartisan group. My thanks to AGs in both parties who worked on this.
Here's what happens next:
Over the next few months, these new default settings will start rolling out.
Kids will hit their limits and go to their parents to ask for more time (as mine do, all the time).
And then those parents will have a conversation with their kids about what's right for them. Maybe the time limit goes up. Maybe down. The point is that parents will be part of that decision in a way they aren't now.
This settlement will prompt _millions_ of those conversations, and that's a big step in the right direction.
Best,
Jeff

I am writing to ask you to dig deep

I am writing to ask you to dig deep and contribute what you can to Dr. Jermaine Johnson's campaign for Governor of South Carolina.
While national Senate candidates get all the attention and donations, this is one of the great overlooked races in the country this cycle.
I know... I know... some of you may be thinking: “Gavin Newsom, what makes you think Democrats have a chance to flip South Carolina's governor's race?”
Let me start with this. During the last Trump midterm election, the Democratic candidate for Governor of South Carolina lost by single digits.
Add to that the fact that he was woefully underfunded and out-raised dramatically by his opponent.
Now consider that the environment is even better for Democrats this cycle, and if we can get our Democratic nominee the resources he needs to win we could just pull off one of the most shocking results of the November election.
I've seen polling that shows this is a 2 point race. So I wanted to reach out to share the audacious thought that if we chip in what we can, we can absolutely win this race. Imagine watching THAT on election night.

Thank you for your consideration of our sponsors.
The Just The Truth Team
Friend,

I have spent thirty years reading voter data. I know what a healthy file looks like — and I know what a gap looks like.

Right now, your file has a gap.

_**[The 2026 Republican Policy Assessment is still sitting incomplete — and that is the one thing I need you to fix before tonight.](https://elink20c.newsletter.joinjustthetruth.com/ss/c/u001._iltqNytX8R9_iqLaPZU6zvdjLjeZKIt1tT_uPEbTC0y7fpsZshSHqaQIQnHKidJaanGEQamQaa_jIkxlg0Mw9xdcAQmmeBJd0zX02n9v55VXqfstl50OMDlbAdEN8DV8vV2wW9lygqNSEgyrtoBkiiVTNc1MYMmRZMy0xvYQTe35Ccci5SWAuIGAm50kBfJjQuqXAo539tETWSksOPBZF78hkETeDpdz0W1VB2CLEFQXjnzsKcAVZyjbEsseGS7goZzQef9hclKNk0kmRF572SEOMZvnJhO4lPyBGzyMYJ3NR0i_49IFtpY6wsQvqxdEwq0bIKU4olrbfrTpoU-c2qFWSGQsgpkxPBunDxhK5Gw1NxIbS3bHSCUP-c1pKYyus_BOmOVLUhMvdAO632IZ0cwPsANXMrRUqR98T2xg-uoy-AAZPEgI9CKZLVuLpaE/4tp/kCFF4fFgS0azI6Ka5bcK6w/h1/h001.Ilex5_aJ6XxHHLH_gbcbYBfMFtmTwu52NE-I7PUOMgQ)**_

Here's why this matters more than you might think.

When we sit down to build our Senate strategy for November, we go list by list, zip code by zip code. We look at who responded, what they care about, and where the intensity is. That data is how we decide where to fight, where to spend, and where to hold the line.

Democrats are not leaving blank files. Their activists are filling out every survey, returning every call, and showing up at every meeting. They are building the most complete voter intelligence operation this party has ever run — and they are doing it right now, while most conservatives are still enjoying their summer.

body:
Follow the money to see who is destroying our public lands

| [|

| | | | Peter, If you want to know exactly how the federal government is managing the lands _you_ own, just follow the money. In Minnesota, the Trump administration is aggressively pushing to allow a toxic sulfide-ore mine right next to the pristine Boundary Waters. The foreign mining company getting the green light **just happens to be owned by a Chilean billionaire who provides a luxury residence to the President’s daughter.** It turns out the going rate for risking the most visited wilderness area in the United States is a nice rental property. You really can't make this stuff up. [**Before we go on, can we count on you to pitch in $3 or more today to our September rapid-response war chest so we can drag these corrupt backroom deals into the light?**](https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/waMpOf2TfGkcqc-vnPyWjw~~/AAUS1hA~/hjVxl8Vpy_P5no5nt4mLa5aH-GCdnRpCMcyIpzUNNNfGRCY838svmTInvsB9Llv8YIW0YfQM2Y9pi-5M03CB1LcYV-nlQf0cuiBx8ClUGZa_b1FsR4RoTSfOehdzRBxIXit9g1kZqBXCP1E7UT-FjcyGg7PksTRpSjmk4uI5uPPGrI_Ec3EczHTcJc93nmJixCKpSnorePwy6Mq2sRrCD8SHqaKjFbnSUafwRHJCqMCNO7JZltc2uZ2GGmme1UsI) **[**DONATE »** ](https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/-raUYVp8uE-J9_hhKSdTFg~~/AAUS1hA~/B6Bs7SlVTBPOVRCLj-ix9TbbeCpM4czb3mZw0RlBu3I3OuEn1I9VEqkkxt3ofHrCSsC0J9CuwrTsT2H_Jn39YGBWalhLtrTx7UTg1PBaaYGki9rTXZfzatXceAt-hbotQy9yKHTKA_Vm6f2Qoo_I1hJ-OOL7mEffDwnnZau8oWVQ1W4a-Y6KvyAMBw8yjdQEhMGx9esnulusgB08_IrGEtYuf6cQnZiVp0GX5qIvpSBMN_k7eTwQJYXs3e5EWe3H) ** The Boundary Waters is just the tip of the spear. The sheer scale of the theft they are attempting across the country is staggering:
* **Out West:** They slashed Bears Ears and Grand Staircase-Escalante by 90% so mining executives could immediately stake uranium claims on sacred archaeological sites.
* **In our National Forests:** They repealed the Roadless Rule, stripping protections from 45 million acres of untouched landscapes just so the timber lobby can clear-cut the backcountry.
* **Down South:** They are waiving environmental laws to bulldoze through sensitive ecosystems, decimating Organ Pipe National Monument and threatening Big Bend for a vanity border wall.

They are robbing us of our national heritage and expecting us to just sit back and take it. They think their billionaire backers have already bought this victory, and they believe they’re untouchable. **We have exactly 62 days until Election Day to prove them wrong.** At Public Land Warriors, we aren't just writing polite letters of complaint. We are building a targeted, inescapable digital ad blitz to hit the airwaves in the home districts of the politicians who are cheering on this destruction. We are going to offer a very clear perspective to the voters in their districts: exactly who these politicians sold them out to. [**Will you pitch in $3, $25, or $50 today to help us fund the backlash and hold these politicians accountable at the ballot box?**](https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/-raUYVp8uE-J9_hhKSdTFg~~/AAUS1hA~/B6Bs7SlVTBPOVRCLj-ix9TbbeCpM4czb3mZw0RlBu3I3OuEn1I9VEqkkxt3ofHrCSsC0J9CuwrTsT2H_Jn39YGBWalhLtrTx7UTg1PBaaYGki9rTXZfzatXceAt-hbotQy9yKHTKA_Vm6f2Qoo_I1hJ-OOL7mEffDwnnZau8oWVQ1W4a-Y6KvyAMBw8yjdQEhMGx9esnulusgB08_IrGEtYuf6cQnZiVp0GX5qIvpSBMN_k7eTwQJYXs3e5EWe3H) **[**DONATE »** ](https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/-raUYVp8uE-J9_hhKSdTFg~~/AAUS1hA~/B6Bs7SlVTBPOVRCLj-ix9TbbeCpM4czb3mZw0RlBu3I3OuEn1I9VEqkkxt3ofHrCSsC0J9CuwrTsT2H_Jn39YGBWalhLtrTx7UTg1PBaaYGki9rTXZfzatXceAt-hbotQy9yKHTKA_Vm6f2Qoo_I1hJ-OOL7mEffDwnnZau8oWVQ1W4a-Y6KvyAMBw8yjdQEhMGx9esnulusgB08_IrGEtYuf6cQnZiVp0GX5qIvpSBMN_k7eTwQJYXs3e5EWe3H) ** Teddy Roosevelt had the foresight to protect these wild spaces so our kids could experience them. | | | I need to tell you about a search term that should make your blood run cold. **_"Had an abortion, search for female."_** That's what a Texas sheriff's office typed into a nationwide surveillance tool to track down a woman who exercised her constitutional right to reproductive care. The search pulled data from more than **6,800 networks and 83,000 cameras** — including cameras right here in Illinois, in a state where abortion is legal. Here's how it works: A company called **Flock Group** sells automatic license plate readers to police departments across the country, marketed as a public safety tool. In reality, it's become a surveillance dragnet — one that lets any local law enforcement agency, anywhere, search a nationwide network of cameras for any reason they type into a box. And it's not just reproductive care. In Richmond, Virginia — a city with an explicit policy against helping federal immigration enforcement — an ATF analyst used Flock's network to run immigration queries anyway. Richmond had to block federal access entirely just to protect its own residents from a company they never agreed to let ICE use. Months ago, I launched a formal investigation into Flock Group alongside Oversight Committee Ranking Member Robert Garcia. We are demanding a full accounting of every search involving "abortion," "ICE," or "CBP." We are demanding Flock's contracts and communications with ICE. We are demanding to know what, if anything, they've done to stop this abuse. I've spent my career fighting for privacy, civil liberties, and reproductive freedom, and I am not going to let a private company build a nationwide tracking network and call it a public service. subject: The Mississippi Wire — September 2, 2026
body:
The week in Mississippi, from The Mississippi Wire. https://mailchi.mp/mspolicy/wl68h10o5b?e=5703353baa
| TheMISSISSIPPI WIRE Latest News, Greatest State
---

| Wednesday, September 2, 2026 | A Publication of the
Mississippi Center for Public Policy | MississippiWire.News
---|---|---

NATIONAL [SNAP water-bill payment resolution fails](https://us.list-manage.com/bFgHK5VkHDB?e=5703353baa&c2id=0d4484d08dfcd99680c1a241a59ef3e3) A proposal by a Mississippi Public Service Commissioner to let SNAP/EBT recipients pay water bills directly with their food-assistance benefits died Tuesday when no other commissioner would second it. [Continue reading →](https://us.list-manage.com/pFFFalPiL41?e=5703353baa&c2id=0d4484d08dfcd99680c1a241a59ef3e3) [DeSoto County lawmakers question cost, fairness and need for new maps at redistricting hearing](https://us.list-manage.com/Xj6FUzG4bQ9?e=5703353baa&c2id=0d4484d08dfcd99680c1a241a59ef3e3) Three DeSoto County-area legislators used a state redistricting hearing in Southaven to challenge the cost of past map fights, the fairness of the county’s judicial voting districts, and whether Mississippi needs to redraw its maps at all.[Read →](https://us.list-manage.com/46Lws2uLf7S?e=5703353baa&c2id=0d4484d08dfcd99680c1a241a59ef3e3) [PERS board certifies $15,433 in delinquent contributions from Town of Chula](https://us.list-manage.com/ukXcXKLXTQa?e=5703353baa&c2id=0d4484d08dfcd99680c1a241a59ef3e3) The Mississippi Public Employees' Retirement System board voted Aug. 27 to certify additional delinquent contributions from the town of Chula, including money withheld from employees' paychecks but never turned over to the pension system.[Read →](https://us.list-manage.com/5gi_PQWbkGj?e=5703353baa&c2id=0d4484d08dfcd99680c1a241a59ef3e3) [Road-paving contract needs review - says local supervisor](https://us.list-manage.com/18StiNyMIul?e=5703353baa&c2id=0d4484d08dfcd99680c1a241a59ef3e3) [Read →](https://us.list-manage.com/N90C1M_N7e6?e=5703353baa&c2id=0d4484d08dfcd99680c1a241a59ef3e3) | Explore Mississippi In Depth
---
[ Tax Dollars -> See how Mississippi spends every dollar you send to Jackson.](https://us.list-manage.com/OnDbHNz5i4p?e=5703353baa&c2id=0d4484d08dfcd99680c1a241a59ef3e3)[ Schools -> How does your local school really measure up?](https://us.list-manage.com/FLPxKCA4uW2?e=5703353baa&c2id=0d4484d08dfcd99680c1a241a59ef3e3)[ Mississippi Wins -> The wins putting Mississippi ahead of the pack.](https://us.list-manage.com/10qdI_ZrVrK?e=5703353baa&c2id=0d4484d08dfcd99680c1a241a59ef3e3)[ Energy -> What's really driving the cost of your energy.](https://us.list-manage.com/_C7FtgxuT3j?e=5703353baa&c2id=0d4484d08dfcd99680c1a241a59ef3e3)

Around Mississippi [Hernando Officials Signal Hiring Freeze for Coming Budget Year](https://us.list-manage.com/7MgGRiAvFJc?e=5703353baa&c2id=0d4484d08dfcd99680c1a241a59ef3e3) HERNANDO -- A Hernando official told the Board of Aldermen the city should add no new employee positions in the next fiscal year, following data on recent payroll growth. [Hernando Mayor Warns of Staff Losses Without 3% Raise](https://us.list-manage.com/dYzP9MXe6fA?e=5703353baa&c2id=0d4484d08dfcd99680c1a241a59ef3e3) HERNANDO -- Hernando's mayor told the Board of Aldermen the city could lose more police officers and firefighters without a pay increase this year. [Natchez Mayor Denies Report of Nearly $1 Million in Bounced City Checks](https://us.list-manage.com/18BZnWjpinD?e=5703353baa&c2id=0d4484d08dfcd99680c1a241a59ef3e3) NATCHEZ -- The mayor called claims that Natchez bounced roughly $1 million in checks "an absolute fabrication" at the Aug. 26 board of aldermen meeting. [Ocean Springs alderman backs lowering short-term rental permit caps](https://us.list-manage.com/18vGa9jUiT5?e=5703353baa&c2id=0d4484d08dfcd99680c1a241a59ef3e3) OCEAN SPRINGS -- An Ocean Springs alderman said Aug. 29 he will support reducing the city's short-term rental permit caps, citing opposition from residents in his ward. [Natchez Alderwoman Warns Proposed Budget Could Leave $500,000 Deficit](https://us.list-manage.com/s9UxyXY2rWH?e=5703353baa&c2id=0d4484d08dfcd99680c1a241a59ef3e3) NATCHEZ -- A Natchez alderwoman cautioned that the city's proposed fiscal year 2027 budget could leave a six-figure shortfall the following year, as the Board of Aldermen reviewed a third draft during a special call meeting last week. [Action Against Nuisance Neighbors - Starkville Aldermen](https://us.list-manage.com/10Urv2MaKQM?e=5703353baa&c2id=0d4484d08dfcd99680c1a241a59ef3e3) STARKVILLE -- [Starkville budgets $442,276 for raises and approves four new police positions](https://us.list-manage.com/r5yV1r4Mz3S?e=5703353baa&c2id=0d4484d08dfcd99680c1a241a59ef3e3) STARKVILLE -- Starkville aldermen set aside $442,276 for general-fund employee raises in fiscal year 2027 and approved four new police department positions at a special call budget meeting on Aug. 26. [Flock-type Camera System for Starkville Approved](https://us.list-manage.com/lDmOpbm15fH?e=5703353baa&c2id=0d4484d08dfcd99680c1a241a59ef3e3) STARKVILLE -- Starkville Board Approves $275,000 for New Police Camera System [Greenwood Leflore school board reviews new high school construction contract](https://us.list-manage.com/11fhgyKeemG?e=5703353baa&c2id=0d4484d08dfcd99680c1a241a59ef3e3) GREENWOOD -- New school takes shape in Delta town [New Youth Court Law Under Fire Locally](https://us.list-manage.com/AWyy3pioM0D?e=5703353baa&c2id=0d4484d08dfcd99680c1a241a59ef3e3) GREENVILLE --
Schools [Mississippi Teachers Get $748 Each for Classroom Supplies, Delivered by Digital Wallet](https://us.list-manage.com/DFQhMLlm62M?e=5703353baa&c2id=0d4484d08dfcd99680c1a241a59ef3e3)State Education Enhancement Funds reach districts Wednesday. For the first time the money moves through ClassWallet, a digital platform that tracks spending and collects receipts automatically.[Read →](https://us.list-manage.com/sCMz7h8qV6Y?e=5703353baa&c2id=0d4484d08dfcd99680c1a241a59ef3e3)
National [Tariffs cost Americans $200 billion a year, add $147 to school supplies](https://us.list-manage.com/G3LPYOZ4qLQ?e=5703353baa&c2id=0d4484d08dfcd99680c1a241a59ef3e3)Tariffs will cost Americans about $200 billion per year, according to the National Taxpayers Union, and school supplies aren’t exempt from the heightened costs[Read →](https://us.list-manage.com/7KazrWUsfbu?e=5703353baa&c2id=0d4484d08dfcd99680c1a241a59ef3e3)[Ocean Springs board goes into closed session over open meetings and records complaints](https://us.list-manage.com/Udq7Lgf1mp1?e=5703353baa&c2id=0d4484d08dfcd99680c1a241a59ef3e3)The Board of Aldermen voted Tuesday night to remain in executive session while discussing litigation that includes a formal open meetings complaint and a public records complaint filed against the city.[Read →](https://us.list-manage.com/18zS3qLCahG?e=5703353baa&c2id=0d4484d08dfcd99680c1a241a59ef3e3)[Contract addendums add to cost of clear up - MDOT](https://us.list-manage.com/Dnd7mhVib4I?e=5703353baa&c2id=0d4484d08dfcd99680c1a241a59ef3e3)[Read →](https://us.list-manage.com/1BGliwtQPe5?e=5703353baa&c2id=0d4484d08dfcd99680c1a241a59ef3e3)
Opinion [They wrote Mississippi off. Today we're thriving.](https://us.list-manage.com/wtzbJIqaJL5?e=5703353baa&c2id=0d4484d08dfcd99680c1a241a59ef3e3)$79 billion invested since 2020. xAI, Amazon and Aluminum Dynamics chose Mississippi over anywhere on earth. What changed was never the soil — it was the rules we chose to live by.[Read →](https://us.list-manage.com/MWZLKkUyx6O?e=5703353baa&c2id=0d4484d08dfcd99680c1a241a59ef3e3)

name: Mike
subject: I'm Running One Race; My Opponent is Running Two
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Mike Van Someren for WI
body:
He wants a different job. Voters deserve to know that.

| | | | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/mikevansomeren/im-running-one-race-my-opponent-is-running-two?e=356c0699dd)
---
| | | | |
---
| | | | | | If you believe you’ve received this message in error, or if you’d like to unsubscribe from this list, [you can do so here](https://MikeVanSomeren.us5.list-manage.com/unsubscribe?u=a8d3e4f455e56b0d81700f39a&id=31c9df9df4&t=b&e=356c0699dd&c=220ecf418d).
---
| |
Hi Friends,
I wanted to let you know about something pretty unusual happening in our race.**I’m running one race. My opponent is running two.** Chris Kapenga is currently running for reelection to the Wisconsin State Senate in November, while also running for Waukesha County Executive in a special election just a few weeks later.And if you’ve been following him lately, it’s becoming pretty clear which race has his attention.His social media is increasingly focused on the County Executive race. His County Executive signs are going up around Waukesha County. And he’s spending a lot of his time campaigning in communities outside the Senate district he currently represents.
And you know what? If Chris wants to be Waukesha County Executive, **he should absolutely be allowed to chase that dream.** But the voters of the 33rd Senate District deserve to know that when they cast their ballots this November.Because he’s still asking them to elect him to another four-year term in the State Senate.And if he wins both races, he has told the media his plan is to leave the Senate and become County Executive — potentially sending our communities right back into the process of choosing another senator shortly after the November election.That doesn't make much sense to me.**I’m running for State Senate because I want to be your State Senator.** I want to represent Delafield, Oconomowoc, Hartland, Sussex, Hartford, Ixonia, and all of the communities across our district. I want to work on making Wisconsin more affordable, strengthening our public schools, supporting workers and businesses, and bringing accountability back to Madison.This isn't a stepping stone for me, and I'm not asking you to elect me to a job I'm already trying to leave.Chris should pursue the job he wants.**I just think the people of the 33rd Senate District deserve a senator who wants the job of representing them.** I do.As always, if you have questions, disagree with me, or just want to tell me what you think our state should be doing differently, hit reply. I read them.
-Mike

I will not stand by and let Trump prevent Americans from exercising their constitutional right to vote.
#
Did you see this news, Peter?
[](https://act.timwalz.com/go/73?c0=stp-ms-em-20260902-1.iu3P3_&amount=5&refcode=em20260902-1041&t=2&akid=1041%2E34582%2EQCdcZR)
**Last week, the U.S. Supreme Court ruled in favor of Donald Trump re: mail-in ballots.**
Ever since 2020, Trump has set his sights on killing mail-in voting while pushing debunked conspiracy theories about voter fraud to back his bogus stolen election claims. MAGA Republicans are actively trying to make it harder to vote because they know _the higher the turnout, the less likely they are to win elections._
So in his second term, Trump issued an executive order attacking vote-by-mail, which **would allow his administration to create its own list of eligible voters and order the U.S. Postal Service to ONLY deliver mail ballots to those people.**
It’s more executive overreach in an attempt to suppress the vote and maintain power. And now, thanks to Trump’s hand-picked far-right justices, it’s one step closer to happening.
Thankfully, this executive order is still temporarily blocked by other courts from going into effect. But I promise you this: Minnesota will continue to lead the fight to protect every voter’s right to an equal voice in our elections.

body:
An issue a day

| |

| | _With just six days until the primary, I am using each day to discuss an issue I have highlighted on the campaign trail. For Day 6, I am highlighting the need to attack political corruption and return power to everyday people._
* * *
Dear David, **We have a corruption problem in America.** The prevalence of big money in our politics has created a never-ending cycle in which politicians take their marching orders from corporate PACs and special interests, and in return, those same donors pour huge amounts of money into political campaigns in order to keep the politicians who do their bidding in office. **[Nothing will ever change as long as the same politicians maintaining a broken status quo remain in office for years and years. If you’re ready to help me bring a new kind of politics to Washington, please pitch in today:](https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/uODOKMlIx_u7QQrF_tPUqQ~~/AAUS1hA~/TEaqnJ21xxOMaSJ_Wq64wTZjUV9dpqv69RpY5WktvH7CMaYf9zqr--96PxCL6GVlqOLl2mMzKgjlBmsK6UHdQ31obDMXFVZz1T9uXZKVX3o8neRrO2oMfLLT7s-3APHct_xyLtkBnlm_H354NG1FZmiWNzcROuZ3TS1qRoKVMn4ULK-4Fl19Yn5wO9kvwVYarcXQw0Z4C5mnMXYosUn-YeUVuu9asRQXO3y_IX1HOh_Ea1_tdic0-gHG76p6LspTRRN__7dO6lmfflOZxLQVHA~~)** | | [DONATE](https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/uODOKMlIx_u7QQrF_tPUqQ~~/AAUS1hA~/TEaqnJ21xxOMaSJ_Wq64wTZjUV9dpqv69RpY5WktvH7CMaYf9zqr--96PxCL6GVlqOLl2mMzKgjlBmsK6UHdQ31obDMXFVZz1T9uXZKVX3o8neRrO2oMfLLT7s-3APHct_xyLtkBnlm_H354NG1FZmiWNzcROuZ3TS1qRoKVMn4ULK-4Fl19Yn5wO9kvwVYarcXQw0Z4C5mnMXYosUn-YeUVuu9asRQXO3y_IX1HOh_Ea1_tdic0-gHG76p6LspTRRN__7dO6lmfflOZxLQVHA~~)
---
More of the same won’t fix this, David. **That’s why I signed the Term Limits on Congress pledge.**
[](https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/uODOKMlIx_u7QQrF_tPUqQ~~/AAUS1hA~/TEaqnJ21xxOMaSJ_Wq64wTZjUV9dpqv69RpY5WktvH7CMaYf9zqr--96PxCL6GVlqOLl2mMzKgjlBmsK6UHdQ31obDMXFVZz1T9uXZKVX3o8neRrO2oMfLLT7s-3APHct_xyLtkBnlm_H354NG1FZmiWNzcROuZ3TS1qRoKVMn4ULK-4Fl19Yn5wO9kvwVYarcXQw0Z4C5mnMXYosUn-YeUVuu9asRQXO3y_IX1HOh_Ea1_tdic0-gHG76p6LspTRRN__7dO6lmfflOZxLQVHA~~)
Term limits for members of Congress and the U.S. Supreme Court are how we start to get things back on track in this country and ensure Congress is filled with leaders who strive to make life better for people, not cling to power and grow their bank accounts.
But term limits alone won’t address the corruption crisis plaguing American politics.
That’s why I also support restoring campaign finance laws that limit the pernicious impact of big money on our political system, closing the revolving door that allows retired legislators to make millions lobbying their former colleagues, and banning politicians (and their spouses) from buying and trading stocks while in office.
**[I refuse to accept corporate PAC money. My campaign is fueled by people like you who chip in whatever you can, whenever you can, to help me bring a new kind of leadership to Congress. So if you’re ready to attack political corruption and get money out of politics, please pitch in to support my campaign today:](https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/uODOKMlIx_u7QQrF_tPUqQ~~/AAUS1hA~/TEaqnJ21xxOMaSJ_Wq64wTZjUV9dpqv69RpY5WktvH7CMaYf9zqr--96PxCL6GVlqOLl2mMzKgjlBmsK6UHdQ31obDMXFVZz1T9uXZKVX3o8neRrO2oMfLLT7s-3APHct_xyLtkBnlm_H354NG1FZmiWNzcROuZ3TS1qRoKVMn4ULK-4Fl19Yn5wO9kvwVYarcXQw0Z4C5mnMXYosUn-YeUVuu9asRQXO3y_IX1HOh_Ea1_tdic0-gHG76p6LspTRRN__7dO6lmfflOZxLQVHA~~)**

clean_body: An issue a day | | | | With just six days until the primary, I am using each day to discuss an issue I have highlighted on the campaign trail. For Day 6, I am highlighting the need to attack political corruption and return power to everyday people. Dear David, We have a corruption problem in America. The prevalence of big money in our politics has created a never-ending cycle in which politicians take their marching orders from corporate PACs and special interests, and in return, those same donors pour huge amounts of money into political campaigns in order to keep the politicians who do their bidding in office. ~~ | | ~~ More of the same won’t fix this, David. That’s why I signed the Term Limits on Congress pledge. ~~ Term limits for members of Congress and the U.S. Supreme Court are how we start to get things back on track in this country and ensure Congress is filled with leaders who strive to make life better for people, not cling to power and grow their bank accounts. But term limits alone won’t address the corruption crisis plaguing American politics. That’s why I also support restoring campaign finance laws that limit the pernicious impact of big money on our political system, closing the revolving door that allows retired legislators to make millions lobbying their former colleagues, and banning politicians (and their spouses) from buying and trading stocks while in office. ~~ If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: | ~ ~ | ~ | ~~ Thank you, Carleigh | Carleigh Beriont is running to represent New Hampshire’s First Congressional District in Congress because Granite Staters deserve a representative who shows up and listens. ~~** | | ~~ | Paid for by Carleigh Beriont for Congress Carleigh Beriont for CongressPO Box 1912Hampton, NH 03843United States "Website"•~~ "Privacy Policy"

subject: IMMEDIATE RELEASE: Vindman refuses to debate.
body:
After the town hall blowup, he won’t face Doug. Statement inside.

| | | | | |
---
| | | | | | FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASESeptember 2, 2026

## **OLLIVANT: VINDMAN’S REFUSAL TO DEBATE IS POLITICAL COWARDICE**
**CULPEPER COUNTY, VA** — Republican congressional candidate Doug Ollivant today issued the following statement on incumbent Rep. Eugene Vindman’s refusal to debate:“Eugene Vindman’s refusal to debate is political cowardice, plain and simple. Virginians deserve leadership that listens, not an entitled elite who uses the word ‘democracy,’ cusses out his own constituents in a town hall, then refuses to engage his opposition in a debate.
Just cowardly behavior.”
Ollivant and his campaign team give their thanks to the organizers who have worked in good faith to put debates on the calendar for the voters of Virginia’s 7th Congressional District. Ollivant, a believer in free-speech, has called for debates across the district.
**About Doug Ollivant**
_Doug Ollivant is a retired U.S. Army Lieutenant Colonel, combat veteran, and Republican nominee for Virginia’s 7th Congressional District. A husband, father of seven, and national security expert with service at the National Security Council and West Point, he is running for Congress to restore fiscal responsibility, strengthen national security, and deliver common-sense solutions for Virginia families, with a focus on manufacturing, good food as a key to health, and energy abundance._

Hey folks,
New reporting claims Melania Trump may not have spent a single night at the White House since Donald Trump returned to office--and I think the story is bigger than their marriage. We're talking about the hypocrisy, the grifting, and the carefully constructed public image surrounding the entire Trump family.
* [**00:01:08**] The bombshell claim: Melania may be living a completely separate life from Donald Trump--and nowhere near the White House.
* [**00:03:40**] A Trump aide's alleged brutal assessment of their marriage, and why the reaction from Trump world says so much.
* [**00:06:16**] The double standard that drives me nuts: imagine how MAGA media would react if a Democratic president were facing these same questions.
* [**00:08:43**] Melania struggles through a prepared statement about Trump's "empathy"--and the awkward moment becomes incredibly revealing.
* [**00:10:25**] Why their marriage ultimately isn't the real story. It's the money, the public persona, and the larger pattern of alleged corruption and grifting surrounding the Trump family.

Peter - I'm going to be straight with you, because that's the only way I know how to do this.

_We just won._ Two elections in two weeks: the special primary, then the runoff.

Grueling doesn't begin to cover it. Every dollar this campaign had went into turning out voters, running ads, and getting our message into every corner of this state.

**And it worked.**

But here's the part nobody tells you on election night: winning a runoff doesn't put a single dollar back in our account. Right now, after everything we just spent, our campaign finances are running on fumes.

**Annie Andrews has $4.1 million.**

She's raised nearly $11 million since she got into this race, from liberal donors across the country. She's had months to build that war chest while we were fighting a two-round primary just to get our name on the November ballot.

Countless conservatives in SC put their trust in me, and I promise to carry forward the conservative agenda for the next six years in the United States Senate. clean_body: Right now, after everything we just spent, our campaign finances are running on fumes. | Peter - I'm going to be straight with you, because that's the only way I know how to do this. We just won. Two elections in two weeks: the special primary, then the runoff. Grueling doesn't begin to cover it. Every dollar this campaign had went into turning out voters, running ads, and getting our message into every corner of this state. And it worked. But here's the part nobody tells you on election night: winning a runoff doesn't put a single dollar back in our account. Right now, after everything we just spent, our campaign finances are running on fumes. Annie Andrews has $4.1 million. She's raised nearly $11 million since she got into this race, from liberal donors across the country. She's had months to build that war chest while we were fighting a two-round primary just to get our name on the November ballot. Countless conservatives in SC put their trust in me, and I promise to carry forward the conservative agenda for the next six years in the United States Senate. After asking me to run, President Trump stood on stage with me and told you why he trusts me, too. I don't intend to let a bigger bank account decide whether I get to keep that promise. The general election is November 3. That sounds far off. It isn't. It's less than 70 days away. Every week between now and then, Annie Andrews's campaign will be on television, in your mailbox, and on your phone - funded by liberal donors who wanted to defeat Lindsey and now, defeat me. We have to be able to answer that, and right now, we can't. My opponent has a $4 million head start. To catch up and rebuild, I need not only patriots who were with us over the last six weeks, but folks who are stepping up for the first time. Don't let the most radical candidate South Carolina Democrats have nominated buy this seat. Thank you for standing with me, Darline Graham United States Senator P.S. **Wednesday, September 2, 2026 -**_** ** U.S. launches strikes on southern Iran, killing 18. Iran launches retaliatory attacks. IRGC says two oil tankers hit Hormuz mines and were disabled. CENTCOM claims 84 vessels redirected during naval blockade. President Donald Trump threatens to escalate attacks, says Gulf allies privy to latest wave of U.S. attacks. Israeli attacks kill Palestinian boy in Jabalia, woman dies of wounds in Deir al-Balah. "Why should a child filling up water die?" Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu visits Gaza, vows no withdrawal. Israeli demolitions, land razing, detentions and settler attacks continue across occupied West Bank. WHO: Water contamination nearly triples in Gaza as rainy season threatens public health crisis. U.S. claims it seized more than $560,000 in cryptocurrency donations intended for Hamas. East Jerusalem teachers strike as Israel imposes curriculum, blocks teacher permits. Israeli attacks kill one, wound another in southern Lebanon as ceasefire violations continue. EU plans new mission to train Lebanese army as UNIFIL mandate nears end. Ed Markey wins Massachusetts Democratic Senate Primary. War Secretary Pete Hegseth continues military purge. Top Pentagon AI official sells AI company stake for millions. Two House Democrats break ranks to save GOP procedural vote. Chinese immigrant found dead hours after entering ICE custody. State Department proposes requiring parents to prove citizenship for children's passports. ICE arrests hold near record high with roughly 50,000 in August. DHS Secretary Markwayne Mullin says ICE could deploy to polling sites for "specific threats." DOJ sues Kansas City schools over gender policy. Tyson lays off 2,500 workers overnight in abrupt Illinois plant closure. Global warming set to exceed 1.5°C within years. Chinese president calls for new Middle East security order during Egypt visit. Germany accuses Russia of drone attack on Leipzig airport, expels diplomats. Germany investigates second power-grid sabotage attempt in 24 hours. South Korean president calls for revival of U.S.-North Korea dialogue. Vanuatu files ICJ case seeking sovereignty over French-controlled Pacific islands. Mexican soldiers kill suspected cartel hitman._

* * *
# Iran
* **U.S. launches strikes on southern Iran, killing 18:** The U.S. expanded its strikes into southern Iran, killing 18 people, Iranian media reported on Wednesday.
* **Island regions:** The U.S. struck several villages on Iran's Qeshm Island, hitting a fish powder factory, and also hit Lavan Island, killing three members of the paramilitary Basij force.
* **Hormozgan:** A U.S. attack [hit](https://substack.com/redirect/0029e59d-52e1-4506-b4bb-669578d64b90?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) a wedding in Sirik on Tuesday, killing at least four people, including a child, and injuring nearly 100 people, 51 of whom were hospitalized, [according](https://substack.com/redirect/ad52d629-5ab6-4a80-beea-16909e8c28e5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to Iran's Health Ministry. Separate U.S. strikes hit a fishing pier and a port authority tower in the city. The U.S. also struck the major southern port city of Bandar Abbas, the city of Jask, and a residential area in the coastal city of Kuhestak. Several parts of the power grid in Hormozgan were also targeted.
* **Kermanshah:** The U.S. killed four Iranian military personnel in an overnight attack on the western province of Kermanshah, according to a statement from Iran's military.
* **Sistan and Baluchestan:** The U.S. struck the port city of Chabahar several times on Tuesday, and hit the nearby city of Konarak as well.
* **Khuzestan:** A U.S. missile struck the outskirts of the Iranian city of Ahvaz, in the country's western Khuzestan province, Iran's Fars news agency reported, and later strikes hit at least two other locations. Tuesday strikes killed at least seven and injured eight others in the province.
* **Kerman:** The U.S. also targeted an airport in the city of Jirfot, in Iran's southeast, Iranian broadcaster IRIB reported, though the attack entailed no casualties and minimal damage to the airport's infrastructure.
* **Bushehr:** Explosions were also heard in the gas hub of Asaluyeh.
* **Markazi:** Iranian forces shot down a U.S. MQ-9 drone over Khomeyn, in central Iran on Tuesday, Tasnim reported.

* **Iran launches retaliatory attacks:** Iranian officials announced that the country would launch "regretful" retaliatory attacks on Tuesday, with a spokesman for the IRGC saying the U.S. would face "severe punishment" for its latest attack on Iran.
* **Jordan:** Iran launched several rockets towards Jordan, claiming a successful strike on the U.S. military barracks at Camp Titin, near the Gulf of Aqaba. Iran claimed it killed several U.S. forces and destroyed "several installations and enemy attack helicopters" at the base, while a U.S. source told Al Jazeera the attack had not caused any injuries or major damage. Iran also claimed a successful ballistic missile strike on a helicopter hangar at the Prince Hassan Base in Jordan, and launched attacks at the city of Mafraq. Jordanian officials claimed that they intercepted 10 of 13 Iranian missiles launched into the kingdom, that the remaining three landed in remote areas, and that no injuries or deaths were recorded.
* **Bahrain:** Iran launched drone attacks on U.S. forces in Bahrain, at the country's Sheikh Isa Airbase, according to a statement issued by Iran's Tasnim news service. Bahrain's Ministry of Interior later reported several missile interceptions over its airspace.
* **Kuwait:** The Kuwaiti army reported that the country's air defenses were responding to attacks by "hostile," Iran-linked drones in its airspace. Kuwait's fire service later said a fire at a residential complex in the capital was brought under control after an alleged Iranian drone strike with no injuries reported. Iran claimed its attack on Kuwait's Ali Al-Salem airbase inflicted casualties.
* **Iraq:** Iran's IRGC said its forces carried out a combined missile and drone attack on U.S. facilities in Erbil province, northern Iraq, killing several U.S. personnel, destroying a repair center and warehouses containing technical equipment. Its claims of casualties and damage have not been independently verified.
* **Syria** : Three missiles aimed at Jordan were intercepted over the eastern Deraa countryside in southern Syria, Al Jazeera reported on Tuesday evening.
* **United Arab Emirates:** Iran said it struck radar stations at the Al-Dhafra and Al-Minhad bases in the UAE on Wednesday. The UAE did not confirm the attacks.
* **IRGC says two oil tankers hit Hormuz mines and were disabled:** The IRGC said two oil tankers hit sea mines and were disabled while attempting to transit the Strait of Hormuz on Wednesday, according to a statement shared on Iranian state media.
* The IRGC claimed that the tankers had attempted a transit through the "illegal" southern route with the help of U.S. operatives, and that they were forced to disembark their crews.
* **CENTCOM claims 84 vessels redirected during naval blockade:** U.S. Central Command (CENTCOM) said as of Tuesday evening, U.S. forces had redirected 84 commercial vessels during its ongoing naval blockade against Iran, adding one vessel redirection to Sunday's toll.
* In a [post](https://substack.com/redirect/f1f484bc-26d5-4e7a-a994-e9b93ef9751d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) on X, CENTCOM added that it had disabled three vessels and boarded two to "ensure compliance."
* **Trump threatens to escalate attacks, says Gulf allies privy to latest wave of U.S. attacks:** President Donald Trump threatened on Tuesday evening to [intensify](https://substack.com/redirect/438cc3cb-4eaf-4398-9cd4-7778571e7d06?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) U.S. attacks on Iran if Tehran retaliated, telling Fox News: "They'll be hit much harder...if it goes a third time, they're going to be totally wiped out as a country."
* He had earlier [claimed](https://substack.com/redirect/018eb136-4b3a-4fe1-a5b9-f37be6361bbe?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) in a Truth Social post that the "biggest attack of them all" was "waiting in the wings," should Iran respond to the latest wave of attacks
* Separately, Trump said that the U.S. had "almost total control" of Hormuz on Tuesday, and dismissed reports that the U.S. was seeking a new agreement with Iran.
* Trump also claimed in his Fox News interview that the U.S.'s Gulf allies were notified before the latest round of U.S. strikes on Iran.

* **Head of Iran 's Supreme National Security Council vows retaliation:** In response to the U.S. attacks, Mohsen Rezaei, the head of Iran's Supreme National Security Council, said in a [post](https://substack.com/redirect/b5351a43-d21b-4d9e-b91c-dc5fa2976203?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg): "You will soon see that Iran's new strategy on the battlefield, in diplomacy, and in confronting the economic blockade will shatter your foundations."
* Iran's foreign ministry spokesman Esmaeil Baqaei called the U.S. bombing of a wedding a "war crime" and said in a [post](https://substack.com/redirect/4628d1be-ed7c-4568-ac35-6aeba3ed67b8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) on X: "The truth of America's illegal war against Iran was revealed last night in #Sirik; where a wedding ceremony was bombed, within the framework of America's desperate attempt to conceal its own defeat; the reality is the crimes that America commits, not the AI-generated videos that falsely depict American officials as morally upright and victorious heroes."
* **Russia affirms solidarity with Iran, Putin tells Pezeshkian:** President Vladimir Putin told Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian at the Shanghai Cooperation Organization meeting on Tuesday that Russia stood in solidarity with the Iranian people. Putin also told Pezeshkian that Russia and Iran would maintain their economic and trade relationship despite U.S. threats against countries that cooperate with Iran.

* **Ghalibaf claims U.S. giving ships "false guarantees" about Hormuz passage: **In a video message shared by Iranian news agencies, parliament speaker Mohammed Bagher Ghalibaf addressed the situation in the Strait of Hormuz, saying that, despite a few "enemy" ships managing to get through the passageway, Iranian forces remained "in complete control" of the Strait and would "not allow it to be opened.
* He claimed the U.S. was giving ships "false guarantees" about their ability to cross a southern route in Hormuz, adding that ships that try to do so are being targeted.
* In his remarks, Ghalibaf also threatened that "no one" would be "able to export oil," should the U.S.'s stranglehold on Iranian oil continue.

* **U.S. previews more sanctions on Iranian business partners:** At the G20 finance meeting on Tuesday, U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said that the U.S. planned to announce new sanctions on "anyone that does business with the IRGC." He also claimed that the U.S. was presently tracking down the group's assets.

* **Saudi shipping firm says two sailors killed in Hormuz transit:** The Saudi shipping company Bahri reported on Wednesday that two Filipino crew members were killed on board the Sidr supertanker in a Monday incident in the Strait of Hormuz.
* **Peru cuts diplomatic ties with Iran:** Peru announced on Tuesday that it had severed diplomatic relations with Iran, accusing Iran of "inciting violence" and "escalating" the conflict in the Middle East, and citing disruptions to shipping in the Strait of Hormuz in a statement from its Foreign Ministry.
* The two countries have had diplomatic relations since November 1973.

* **USS Abraham Lincoln arrives in Thailand after more than 6 months at sea:** After more than 200 consecutive days at sea, the U.S. Navy aircraft carrier Abraham Lincoln arrived in Thailand on Wednesday, Reuters reported. The vessel plans to dock in the Southeast Asian country for five days.
* The vessel has been plagued by reports of deteriorating conditions on board and concerns over the mental health of some sailors and marines after its long deployment.

# Palestine
* **Killed and wounded in Gaza:** Over the past 24 hours, eight Palestinians were killed and 31 were injured in attacks across Gaza, according to the Palestinian Ministry of Health. One Palestinian was killed in a building collapse, bringing the number of people killed in building collapses to 34.
* The total recorded death toll since October 7, 2023 has risen to 73,470 killed, with 174,540 injured. Since October 11, the first full day of the so-called ceasefire, Israel has killed at least 1,334 Palestinians in Gaza and wounded 4,429, while 815 bodies have been recovered from under the rubble.
* **Israeli attacks kill Palestinian boy in Jabalia, woman dies of wounds in Deir al-Balah:** A Palestinian boy was [killed](https://substack.com/redirect/548f6996-9223-4a19-84fb-6c74456f9f0b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) and another person wounded in an Israeli strike on the Al-Hawja area of Jabalia refugee camp in northern Gaza on Wednesday, according to WAFA. In central Gaza, a 51-year-old woman died from wounds sustained from Israeli forces a day earlier.
* **" Why should a child filling up water die?":** An Israeli attack in the Al-Katiba area of western Gaza City killed four, including two children and a woman, and wounded eight, on Tuesday. Families had gathered to collect water in the area.
* "The water tanker came, and we started filling up water, us and our children," Faiza Al-Bahtini, the aunt of one of the children killed, told Drop Site's Mohamed Ahmed. "Then we heard gunfire coming from every direction. After that, the vehicles came, the Israelis started bombing, and the massacre happened."
* The Israeli military claimed it was targeting the head of Hamas's internal security apparatus in Gaza and strikes were carried out to "remove threats."
* Abu al-Abd, an eyewitness who was filling water with his four children, said: "What is the crime of a child filling up water? ... Because a child was filling up water, Netanyahu shot at him. What have these children done to you?" **Watch Ahmed 's dispatch [here](https://substack.com/redirect/393d5574-7323-4c15-a14b-f1ed291077c4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).**
* **Netanyahu visits Gaza, vows no withdrawal:** Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu visited an Israeli military post near the "yellow line" in Gaza on Wednesday. * **Israeli demolitions, land razing, detentions and settler attacks continue across occupied West Bank:**

* **Salfit:** Israeli forces [detained](https://substack.com/redirect/24d04d0a-9785-4344-98b6-6662309ef36c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) Deir Ballut Mayor and three other Palestinians while they were on agricultural land west of the town on Wednesday. * **Nablus:** Israeli settlers [attacked](https://substack.com/redirect/a4cd846f-4de4-45d5-b1af-a4ce95d0cea2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) the eastern area of Beita, south of Nablus, early Wednesday and set fire to two Palestinian vehicles parked outside homes.
* **East Jerusalem:** Israeli authorities [demolished](https://substack.com/redirect/7925aaad-0379-4520-9e44-d8c9f1ba6884?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) a three-story residential building in the Al-Bustan neighborhood of Silwan, on Wednesday. * **Palestinian ministry documents pattern of Israeli restrictions on Islamic holy sites in August:** Israel [intensified](https://substack.com/redirect/fa63f39d-7d97-4cb4-927c-0f4828369089?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) restrictions on Islamic holy sites in August, with 26 incursions into Al-Aqsa Mosque and the call to prayer blocked 155 times at Hebron's Ibrahimi Mosque, according to the Palestinian Ministry of Awqaf. The ministry also documented restrictions on worshippers, settler incursions at Al-Aqsa, and attacks on mosques and Islamic shrines elsewhere in the occupied West Bank.
* **Hamas condemns Israeli attacks on Gaza in talks with mediators, Mladenov:** Hamas said on Wednesday it held talks with mediators and "Board of Peace" High Representative Nickolay Mladenov, condemning Israeli attacks on Gaza that killed and wounded Palestinians. The group urged ceasefire mediators and guarantors to "exert the utmost pressure" on the Israeli government to halt its attacks, saying Israel is taking "deliberate escalatory steps" aimed at undermining the ceasefire and efforts to complete its implementation.
* **WHO: Water contamination nearly triples in Gaza as rainy season threatens public health crisis:** The World Health Organization [warned](https://substack.com/redirect/a7d6e704-64a4-42a5-8ff7-a021074632bc?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) on Tuesday that the approaching rainy season could worsen Gaza's public health crisis, with flooding threatening to spread sewage, waste and contaminated water through overcrowded displacement camps. Microbiological contamination in tested water samples nearly tripled this year, while cases of acute watery diarrhoea rose from about 27,000 in March to more than 48,000 in August.
* The organization called for the "unimpeded and expedited entry of humanitarian supplies" to prevent a further deterioration, as Israel continues to restrict the entry of life essentials into Gaza.

* **U.S. claims it seized more than $560,000 in cryptocurrency donations intended for Hamas:** The U.S. Justice Department [announced](https://substack.com/redirect/b5018203-fb14-4cd3-9aeb-9caa6eb4f8e6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) on Wednesday that the FBI seized more than $560,000 in cryptocurrency donations it claimed was intended for Hamas. It also said authorities took control of web domains and communication platforms allegedly used for fundraising and recruitment, and obtained information on thousands of people it says had contacted Hamas seeking to donate money.
* **East Jerusalem teachers strike as Israel imposes curriculum, blocks teacher permits** : Teachers at private and Christian schools in occupied East Jerusalem launched an open-ended strike Tuesday as the academic year began, protesting Israel's requirement that all new first and seventh-grade classes at Palestinian-majority municipal schools use the Israeli curriculum exclusively, according to Al Jazeera.
* The change will affect more than 45,000 students, or one in three Palestinian students in the city.
* Israel has also blocked entry permits for more than 70 West Bank teachers and staff without warning, according to the General Secretariat for Christian Educational Institutions in Jerusalem, which called the abrupt reversal "unprecedented."
* A Knesset law passed earlier this year barring employment of teachers with Palestinian Authority degrees compounds the crisis, since about 60% of East Jerusalem's Arab educators hold such degrees.

# Lebanon
* **Israeli attacks kill one, wound another in southern Lebanon as ceasefire violations continue:** Israeli attacks across southern Lebanon on Wednesday [killed](https://substack.com/redirect/c4ec5db0-7501-4219-ad56-dff34a98be76?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) one person and wounded another in Nabatieh, where a drone struck the Al-Ruwais neighborhood, Lebanon's National News Agency reported. Israeli drones also struck the Al-Deir and Al-Maslah neighborhoods of Nabatieh, including an apartment hit by a guided missile.
* Israeli forces also [carried out](https://substack.com/redirect/ed0c03a1-90fd-45c2-a894-e04cb02c8ea0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) a large explosion in Kfar Tebnit, as well as explosions near Mansouri and Majdal Zoun in the Tyre district and in Houla.
* Israeli attacks continue to displace Lebanese residents of the south, with UNHCR spokesperson telling the Anadolu News Agency that "more than 350,000 people remain displaced across Lebanon while approximately 860,000 people have returned to their communities of origin or nearby areas although many continue to face significant challenges and these should not be considered durable returns." Around 23,000 people remain in shelters.

* **EU plans new mission to train Lebanese army as UNIFIL mandate nears end:** The European Union is planning a new mission to advise and train Lebanese soldiers, including on border and maritime security, EU foreign policy chief Kaja Kallas said on Wednesday. "We are investing in Lebanon's capacity to provide security for itself," Kallas said, stressing that the mission would not replace UNIFIL, whose mandate expires on December 31 after 48 years. The EU aims for a decision to launch the mission in October.

# U.S. News
* **Ed Markey wins Massachusetts Democratic Senate Primary:** Democratic Sen. **Ed Markey** easily defeated Rep. **Seth Moulton** in Massachusetts' Senate primary, winning about two-thirds of the vote despite being outspent on ads by more than $3 million. Markey, 80, campaigned on his liberal record as an author of the Green New Deal and supporter of "Medicare for All," touting endorsements from Sens. **Bernie Sanders** and **Elizabeth Warren** and Rep. **Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez** , while attacking Moulton's past criticism of the party's left flank and his previous comments about transgender athletes.
* **Hegseth 's military purge tops 80 generals and admirals:** War Secretary **Pete Hegseth** has [fired](https://substack.com/redirect/c55c47d1-0575-4d88-a6dd-9b7211485732?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) or blocked the promotions of more than 80 generals and admirals, roughly 10% of the military's top officers, according to The New York Times.
* In the past week, Hegseth has removed seven Army officers selected for two-star general rank, two of whom are black and two of whom are female.
* Army Secretary**Daniel P. Driscoll** recently resigned in protest, warning President Donald Trump directly that the firings have imperiled Army modernization and damaged morale by undermining faith in a promotion system meant to be apolitical.
* **Top Pentagon AI official sells AI company stake for millions:** **Emil Michael** , the Pentagon's top official overseeing military AI policy, [sold](https://substack.com/redirect/5910fd6d-70e9-4ef2-b6cb-34b3f7a30b16?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) his holdings in AI search engine Perplexity for between $5 million and $25 million in June, according to financial disclosures reviewed by the Guardian, following an earlier disclosed sale of his stake in **Elon Musk 's** xAI that netted gains of between 400% and 4,800%.
* Michael also sold holdings in financial software firm Brex, backed by **Peter Thiel** and recently acquired by Capital One, for at least $5 million in April, a gain of at least 473% from the $750,000 maximum value he reported in March 2025.
* Michael, who previously served as Uber's chief business officer, received a personal loan from Perplexity in 2025 and sat on its advisory board before stepping down upon entering federal service.
* **Two House Democrats break ranks to save GOP procedural vote:** Democratic Reps. **Jared Golden** of Maine and **Marie Gluesenkamp Perez** of Washington [provided](https://substack.com/redirect/3e5a7315-2bf9-4a83-91c5-c5652ae0c79f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) the necessary votes on Tuesday to advance a key GOP procedural vote, stalled by five Republican defections, which set up votes on several GOP-led bills, including a controversial resolution condemning socialism.
* Golden and Gluesenkamp Perez said they supported the measure because it enabled passage of a bill pushed by Golden which would delay fishing regulations and potentially benefit Maine lobstermen. That bill later passed 219-196.
* House Minority Leader **Hakeem Jeffries** and Minority Whip **Katherine Clark** both said they were not given advance notice of Golden and Gluenskamp Perez's votes.
* **Chinese immigrant found dead hours after entering ICE custody:** **Lianyong Wei** , a 51-year-old Chinese immigrant, was [found](https://substack.com/redirect/89bf2801-c322-48dc-9767-713a2e14dc3d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) unresponsive during morning checks and pronounced dead on August 23, less than a day after being taken into ICE custody at a facility in the Northern Mariana Islands. His cause of death remains under investigation.
* Wei, whose legal status had ended in 2019, had been arrested by local police on August 21 after allegedly attacking a family in their home.
* Wei's death is the 57th of an immigrant in ICE custody since the start of Trump's second term, 24 of which have occurred since January 1.
* **State Department proposes requiring parents to prove citizenship for children 's passports**: The State Department has [proposed](https://substack.com/redirect/2365e6fe-814b-4dde-a5b6-93bb64291057?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) requiring parents applying for their children's passports to provide proof of their own citizenship or immigration status as part of President Donald Trump's latest effort to limit birthright citizenship, according to draft guidance reviewed by Reuters.
* Under the proposal, parents of applicants would need to submit documents such as a valid U.S. passport, birth certificate, or immigration papers like an I-94 form or green card.
* The proposal follows an August 6 executive order targeting "birth tourism," following an earlier executive order limiting U.S. citizenship to children of green card holders, which the Supreme Court found to be unlawful.
* **ICE arrests hold near record high with roughly 50,000 in August** : ICE officers and agents [arrested](https://substack.com/redirect/758e9836-2a55-4691-9a77-26fffe525b36?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) approximately 50,000 people in August, roughly matching July's record total, NBC News reported, citing a senior Department of Homeland Security official familiar with preliminary data.
* The toll has continued rising since May after a sharp drop in February and March, with June and July both setting arrest records.
* The buildup is fueled by a roughly $70 billion funding package Republicans narrowly passed through the House in June, making ICE the wealthiest law enforcement agency in American history. With that funding, the agency has announced that it will purchase "turnkey" detention facilities and controversial new tools, including electric gloves and robot dogs.
* **Mullin says ICE could deploy to polling sites for "specific threats":** Homeland Security Secretary **Markwayne Mullin** [said](https://substack.com/redirect/d3d86624-99b9-400d-9300-ddbac8914dbd?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) Tuesday that ICE could enter polling places to serve warrants on tracked individuals or respond to "specific threats." He maintained that ICE would not "patrol polling places."
* A DHS statement echoed Mullin, saying "ICE is not planning operations targeting polling locations" but that agents conducting "intelligence-driven targeted enforcement" could make arrests at a location if "an active public safety threat" were present there.
* Tuesday's comments follow Mullin's comments in July, in which he claimed that immigration agents were reviewing state voter rolls "looking for illegal aliens and those who are ineligible to vote."
* **DOJ sues Kansas City schools over gender policy, first such federal action** : The Justice Department [sued](https://substack.com/redirect/0baca75f-44df-4dc3-8da8-6b4de700344e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) Kansas City, Kansas Public Schools Tuesday, accusing the district of facilitating "secret transition" of students' gender without parental knowledge, marking the first federal lawsuit against a public school district over gender identity policy.
* The suit alleges that the district violated the Family Educational Rights and Privacy Act and the Protection of Pupil Rights Amendment by not requiring parental consent before discussing gender identity or changing students' names and pronouns.
* The lawsuit comes nearly six months after the Supreme Court ruled to temporarily suspend policies in California that allowed public school teachers to avoid outing transgender students to their parents.
* **Federal judge strikes down New York 's climate "superfund" law**: Judge **Brenda K. Sannes** of the Northern District of New York ruled Monday that New York's 2024 climate superfund law, which required large fossil fuel companies to pay $75 billion over 25 years for climate resilience projects, is unenforceable, finding it conflicts with federal law.
* Sannes, an Obama appointee, relied heavily on a 2021 Second Circuit ruling dismissing a similar New York City lawsuit against oil companies.
* Several Republican-led states, including West Virginia, had argued that the law was illegal, and that only the federal government has the authority to regulate greenhouse gases.
* **Tyson lays off 2,500 workers overnight in abrupt Illinois plant closure** : Tyson Foods abruptly shuttered its beef plant in Joslin, Illinois on August 14, laying off 2,500 workers, mostly immigrants from Africa, Latin America.
* Tyson claimed that it closed the facility in response to a nationwide cattle shortage, driven partly by drought and the Iran war's effect on fertilizer and diesel costs. Tyson's operating income, however, rose 8%, or $547 million, over the past year and its CEO, **Donnie King** , earned nearly $35 million last year, 781 times the median worker's pay.
* UFCW Local 1546, which represents the workers, said it was not given advance notice. Its leadership later signed a severance agreement providing one to four weeks of pay on top of two months of wage continuation, an agreement criticized by several workers.
* More on the Joslin plant closure, and the union response to it, is available from Labor Notes [here](https://substack.com/redirect/3a09d323-9fc8-44b8-8e4c-e0858c48324d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).

# Other International News
* **Global warming set to exceed 1.5 °C within years, UN warns:** The world is likely to [cross](https://substack.com/redirect/e08f7522-78a6-4a30-a84f-454a048b9a9c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) the Paris Agreement's key 1.5°C warming threshold within the next few years, intensifying extreme weather and threats to ecosystems, glaciers and low-lying coastal cities, according to the UN Environment Programme.
* With an "overshoot" now extremely likely, governments must focus on limiting how far and how long temperatures remain above 1.5°C. UNEP said returning temperatures below the threshold remains possible but "highly uncertain."
* Even if every existing national climate pledge is implemented, warming is projected to peak at approximately 1.8°C above preindustrial levels. Under current government policies, median warming is projected to reach roughly 2.6°C by 2100.
* **U.S. won 't negotiate on commerce, diplomacy with Cuba: **The Trump administration won't [discuss](https://substack.com/redirect/c9632a93-897c-445b-92bb-20bb5fd6a49a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) commerce, diplomacy, or any other issue that could ease the suffering caused by U.S. sanctions, Cuban officials told Bloomberg on Tuesday.
* "The channel for dialogue is at a complete standstill," said Lianys Torres Rivera, Cuba's top diplomat in Washington. The two sides cannot even agree on an agenda. "There are no negotiations."
* Meanwhile, President Donald Trump and Secretary of State Marco Rubio are tightening economic pressure to force Cuba's leaders from power, including through a de facto fuel blockade, as the island faces rising infant mortality and preventable deaths.

* **Chinese president calls for new Middle East security order during Egypt visit:** Chinese President Xi Jinping [urged](https://substack.com/redirect/bfe95992-12e8-482e-97d9-2d28477c786d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) Middle Eastern countries to oppose external interference and become "masters of their own destiny" during talks with Egyptian President Abdel Fattah al-Sisi in Cairo on Wednesday that also saw the signing of numerous bilateral economic deals.
* Xi said China was prepared to work with regional countries to safeguard shipping routes following disruptions in the Strait of Hormuz and Bab al-Mandeb. China and Egypt agreed to deepen security cooperation and counterterrorism coordination.
* The two countries also agreed to expand cooperation on data centers, semiconductors and critical-minerals supply chains and increase the use of their currencies in bilateral trade. Egypt's Suez Canal Economic Zone has already attracted around $4 billion in Chinese investment.

* **Germany accuses Russia of drone attack on Leipzig airport, expels diplomats:** German Interior Minister Alexander Dobrindt [said](https://substack.com/redirect/02e9b40d-7980-43c1-a50b-1c9a3b76cff5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) Tuesday that investigators found proof Russian agents controlled the explosive-laden drone found near a Ukrainian cargo plane at Leipzig-Halle Airport on August 4, calling it part of "a broader pattern of Russian hybrid operations in Europe."
* In response, German Foreign Minister Johann Wadephul said the country would summon its Russian ambassador, close Russia's consulate general in Bonn and the Russian House cultural center in Berlin, and push for additional EU sanctions and travel restrictions on Russian nationals.
* Russian President Vladimir Putin rejected the accusations at the SCO summit in Bishkek, calling Germany's response a "serious mistake" and suggesting Berlin had "fabricated" the evidence.
* European and NATO leaders quickly backed Germany, with NATO Secretary General Mark Rutte saying the evidence was "clear", and European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen announcing that EU foreign ministers would prepare additional sanctions at an upcoming meeting.
* **Germany investigates second power-grid sabotage attempt in 24 hours:** German police are [investigating](https://substack.com/redirect/32ab7f8f-8d94-4a0f-a91c-04c53b145001?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) apparent deliberate damage to a power substation near Bergheim in western Germany, the second suspected attack on the country's electricity grid within a day.
* The incident followed an attack on a critical high-voltage node in Brandenburg, where devices carrying conductive material damaged power lines.
* The attacks came after Berlin accused Russia of attempting to use drones to strike a Ukrainian cargo plane at Leipzig/Halle airport last month. Moscow denied involvement, while EU foreign-policy chief Kaja Kallas said the incident bore "all the hallmarks of state-sponsored terrorism."
* German officials described the timing as "extremely suspicious" ahead of this weekend's Saxony-Anhalt election.

* **South Korean president calls for revival of U.S.-North Korea dialogue:** South Korean President Lee Jae Myung said conditions should be [created](https://substack.com/redirect/732464d4-9bfe-4dec-b02e-b0ddeecb2298?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) for Washington and Pyongyang to resume talks and called for replacing the Korean Peninsula's armistice system with a permanent peace framework.
* Lee also pledged to complete the transfer of wartime operational control of South Korean forces from the United States before his term ends in 2030.
* South Korea's intelligence agency said this week that North Korea and the United States were showing signs of preparing to resume dialogue, although no direct contacts have been confirmed.
* **Vanuatu files ICJ case seeking sovereignty over French-controlled Pacific islands:** Vanuatu [filed](https://substack.com/redirect/04a4d12c-3675-40c5-9ac8-435577e17f3a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) an application with the International Court of Justice on Tuesday, seeking sovereignty over Matthew Island and Hunter Island, two uninhabited volcanic islands currently controlled by France.
* The case, which will not proceed unless France consents to the court's jurisdiction, seeks to resolve a decades-old dispute rooted in the area's colonial past.
* Vanuatu argues its decolonization from joint French-British rule, which ended in 1980, remains incomplete without the islands' return. Vanuatu and France have had two previous rounds of bilateral negotiations over the islands, and agreed to a third round in 2026.
* The islands are located about 300 kilometers from French-controlled New Caledonia, and include significant fishing rights and access to seabed resources.
* **Mexican soldiers kill suspected cartel hitman** : Mexican soldiers [killed](https://substack.com/redirect/28ff3fc7-71d5-4593-b589-9f9dcdcd2cd5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) Luis Enrique Barragan Chavez, a suspected top hitman for the Los Reyes cartel faction of the Carteles Unidos criminal group during an operation in Michoacan on Tuesday, according to Mexico's defense ministry.
* The U.S. had offered a $3 million reward for information leading to Barragan's arrest and had indicted him on drug conspiracy and firearms charges.
* Mexican authorities said soldiers came under fire during the clash, in which another suspected cartel associate was reportedly killed.

Photo by Morteza Akhondi/Getty Images. Wednesday, September 2, 2026 - U.S. launches strikes on southern Iran, killing 18. Iran launches retaliatory attacks. Russia affirms solidarity with Iran. Iranian Parliament Speaker Mohammed Bagher Ghalibaf claims U.S. giving ships "false guarantees" about Hormuz passage. U.S. previews more sanctions on Iranian business partners. Saudi shipping firm says two sailors killed in Hormuz transit. Peru cuts diplomatic ties with Iran.
